title: Reglia
description: A free, server-run Discord and Minecraft chat bridge that you control, including in-game GIF viewing, powered only by native Discord tools.
body:
# Reglia
## Discord Minecraft Chat Bridge

Introducing Reglia, a lightweight but powerful Discord to Minecraft chat bridge that synchronizes your Discord server chat with your Minecraft server in real time using bot tokens and Discord webhooks.

No premium APIs. No paid infrastructure. Zero cost. Just pure real time synchronization handled securely server side.

## What Reglia Does

- Syncs messages between Discord and Minecraft in real time  
- Uses Discord webhooks to push Minecraft chat into Discord
- Uses a Discord bot token (server side) to read Discord messages and relay them into Minecraft  
- Requires no external service fees or paid hosting  
- Runs fully on your own server backend  
- Keeps you in control of your data and community  
- Allows you to view GIFs Ingame!


## Why Reglia Exists

Most chat bridge mods depend on third party APIs, premium hosting, or paid middleware. Reglia removes that barrier by using Discord's existing ecosystem. If you already own a Discord server, a bot token, and a webhook, you already have everything you need.

## Current Stage

Reglia is in **Alpha Development**. Early builds, updates, fixes, and documentation will be released through official channels as development progresses. 

## Who Reglia is For

Server owners and communities who want:

- A seamless Discord ↔ Minecraft chat room experience  
- A free bridge powered by backend logic, not client side tricks  
- Full control without subscriptions or compromises  
- A system that makes Discord and Minecraft feel like one unified space  

Reglia is built for you.
